SLIDE 1: TITLE
Kestrelline — automated claims audit for regional health insurers

SLIDE 2: PROBLEM
Regional insurers audit medical claims by sampling, so most billing errors are never reviewed
before the claim is paid.

SLIDE 3: SOLUTION
Kestrelline checks every claim against the provider contract and the policy rules before payment.

SLIDE 4: TRACTION
Annual revenue of $1.1M, which is 5% of mid-market claims-audit software spend.
Since launch, a 35% reduction in cost per claim audited.
Over the same period, a 12% increase in claims audited per dollar of audit spend.

SLIDE 5: FINANCIALS
Cash in the bank: $3.1M as of January 2027.
Burn plan: $120K per month from January 2027 through December 2027.
2028 burn budget: $2.4M for the year, from January 2028, as the sales team is hired.
Runway: 44 months.

SLIDE 6: TEAM
Two founders: a former payment-integrity lead at a regional insurer, and a former data
platform engineer.

SLIDE 7: ASK
Raising $3.65M seed at $14M post-money.

[Note: 7 slides. Kestrelline is FICTIONAL — no real founder or company data.]
